Sword double attacks 28 damage per hit and bashes 17 max per round and somehow is an aggro magnet. Don't expect to get much out of this 700 mana sinkhole.

Some wizards use this spell, plus a reclaim energy item, as an extra reserve mana battery. This tactic can be situationally useful but is often unreliable. Wizards with low conjuration may find it help to increase the skill by repeatedly casting [[Eye of Zomm]] or [[Halo of Light]].

spells.name: Focus of Spirit
spells.description:
Focuses your target's spiritual energy, granting increased hit points, strength, and dexterity for 1 hour(s) 40.0 mins.
This spell has an unusual stacking mechanic. If a character has Focus, it will block the addition of [[Maniacal Strength]], [[Mortal Deftness]], and [[Voice of the Berserker]] spells. ''However'' if the character already has those buffs prior, the addition of Focus on top of those will not overwrite them, rather it will stack and both will apply to the character's statistics. Therefore, if a melee character would like all three buffs, they should click off any pre-existing Focus, then ask the [[Shaman]] for them.
Focus of Spirit will always overwrite other Talisman spells however. It also seems to overwrite lower level spells such as [[Dexterity]].

Does not stack with [[Shield of the Magi]] and other INT caster HP buffs. Does not stack with [[Bedlam]] and other enchanter mat-free runes in that line. Does stack with [[Resurrection Effects]].

Provides your target with mystic fortitude, increasing their hit points and armor class for 2 hour(s) 24.0 mins.

This spell trades the higher AC and HP of [[Heroism]] for a longer total duration. However, due to the lack of a group version of this spell (such as [[Heroic Bond]] for Heroism), and the lower total stats, Clerics tend to use Heroism and Heroic Bond instead, until getting [[Aegolism]] (which lasts roughly as long as Fortitude while keeping the stats of Heroic Bond).

spells.name: Frenzied Strength
spells.description: Focuses your target's strength into an intense burst, increasing it for a short time, but then gradually decaying over the next 3 min.

spells.name: Frost
spells.description: Covers your target in glistening ice, causing 762 damage, and lowering their fire resistance (this is the game's descriptive text, but the spell does not actually lower fire resistance). Each cast yields approximately 3.04 damage per mana.

spells.name: Gangrenous Touch of Zum`uul
spells.description:
Drains your target of life energy, siphoning 720 hit points. 1.77 lifetap efficiency. This spell is disease-based and mostly worthless. It may be beneficial in PVP. [[Touch of Night]] is same amount of dmg and 10 mana less with a better -modifier. 

Does not land on: 
* ToV Dragons
* VP Dragons
* Zlandicar, Klandicar, Sontalak
* Other high raid targets
* PoG trash mobs
* Most Giants

spells.name: Gift of Brilliance
spells.description:
Grants your target increased mental capacities, increasing their mana pool and mana regeneration. ** Will overwrite [[Form of the Howler]] **

This spell is dissimilar to [[Brilliance]] which buffs INT.

spells.name: Gift of Insight
spells.description:
Grants your target increased mental capacities, increasing their mana pool and mana regeneration.  Overwrites [[Gift of Magic]].

This spell is dissimilar to [[Insight]] which buffs WIS.

You must have a minimum level of 42 to receive this.

spells.name: Gift of Pure Thought
spells.description:
Calms your group's thoughts, allowing them to regenerate mana more quickly. This spell is identical to [[Clarity II]], but it affects your whole group.

Also, as an added point of information, everyone in a group within appropriate physical range regardless of level can receive any group buff, so long as the caster does not have a lower level targeted when trying to cast the spell. Meaning, a level 1 can receive this buff.

Extra Cool Move: By Default, F7 targets the nearest player. When casting a GROUP BUFF, target yourself, then while the spell is casting hit F7 and it will land on that player AND their group regardless of level. This comes from a level 60 druid using the Regen Clicky and PoTG on low level groups all the time.

spells.name: Gift of Xev
spells.description: Focuses mana into the form of a meal pack filled with food and drink.

spells.name: Girdle of Karana
spells.description: Fills your target with the power of the stone, increasing their strength for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

spells.name: Glamour of Kintaz
spells.description:
Causes your opponent to fall into an enchanted sleep for up to 30 secs (5 ticks). This spell works on creatures up to level 57. (9.16 mana per second)

This spell formerly had a -10MR resist modifier, but it was removed in 2014. [https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=155457]

spells.name: Glamour of Tunare
spells.description: Dazzles your targeted [[:Category:Animal | animal]] with the glamour of Tunare, making them more vulnerable to magic.

spells.name: Greater Vocaration: Air
spells.description: Summons an air elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Greater Vocaration: Earth
spells.description: Summons an earth elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Greater Vocaration: Fire
spells.description: Summons a fire elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Greater Vocaration: Water
spells.description: Summons a water elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Greater Wolf Form
spells.description: Fills you with the spirit of the wild, allowing you to take the form of a wolf, increasing your movement speed, and attack rating.

spells.name: Grounding Strike
spells.description: Blocks the nerves to your opponent's legs, rooting them for up to 0:01:00.

spells.name: Heroic Bond
spells.description: Provides your group with heroic valor, increasing their hit points and armor class for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.description: Provides your target with heroic valor, increasing their hit points and armor class for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins. Blocks Skin Like Nature and Natureskin.

spells.name: Hobbling Strike
spells.description: Cuts circulation to your target's legs, slowing their movement speed for up to 0:03:00.

spells.name: Hsagra's Wrath
spells.description:
'''Eligible Targets:''' * [[Derakor the Vindicator]] * [[King Tormax]] * [[Velketor the Sorcerer]] * [[Narandi the Wretched]] * [[Lord Yelinak? (According to Vatrulak, unverified)]]
Consumes your target in the wrath of Hsagra, causing 2000 damage to certain types of giants. Consumes a pair of peridots when cast.


Can only be cast on a select list of mobs! See list at right.

spells.name: Ice Spear of Solist
spells.description:
Creates a fierce spear of ice to strike your target, causing between 1076 and @1 damage.
This is the Wizard's largest cold DD, and the logical upgrade of [[Ice Comet]].

spells.name: Ice Strike
spells.description: Creates a rift of bitter cold, causing between 645 and 675 damage to your target. 2.58 to 2.7 DPM.

spells.name: Identify
spells.description:
Provides magical information about the item that your target is holding.


To use the spell on yourself, pick the item you want to identify from your inventory by left clicking it, so that it's held on your cursor (as if you were moving the item). Then, with the item held on your cursor, target yourself and cast the spell.

To use the spell on others, have them hold their item to be identified on their cursor while you cast the spell on them.

This spell doesn't exist in EQL for classes to scribe.

spells.name: Immobilize
spells.description: Causes the earth to adhere to your target's feet, preventing them from moving for up to 1 min.

spells.name: Improved Invisibility
spells.description: Cloaks you in a mystic veil, rendering you invisible to many creatures for 10 min.

spells.name: Inferno of Al`Kabor
spells.description:
Creates an inferno that causes 750 damage to five creatures in the vicinity of your target.
Single target mana efficiency of 1.2 DPM.

spells.name: Infusion
spells.description: Fuels your mind with energy taken from an [[Essence Emerald]].  Consumes an [[Essence Emerald]] when cast.

spells.name: Insidious Decay
spells.description: Infects your target with a fever, causing them to become more susceptible to other diseases. This spell cannot be resisted. [[Insidious Malady]](lv39) can be resisted, but has a stronger effect.

spells.name: Instill
spells.description: Causes the earth to adhere to your target's feet, preventing them from moving for up to 1 min 36s.

spells.name: Invert Gravity
spells.description: Causes a sudden reversal in the gravity around your target, doing between 368 and 380 initial damage and causing them to fly high into the air.

spells.name: Jonthan's Inspiration
spells.description: An ancient war song that increases your attack speed, strength, and attack rating.

spells.name: Jyll's Wave of Heat
spells.description:
Creates a circle of intense heat around you, causing between 638 and 648 damage to all nearby creatures.
Single target mana efficiency of 1.86 / 1.9 DPM.

spells.name: Jyll`s Static Pulse
spells.description:
Creates a circle of static energy around you, causing 495 damage and and a short duration stun to all nearby creatures.
Single target mana efficiency of 1.63. Compared to [[Supernova]], this spell is more mana efficient and has a reduced recast time, but hits for less damage, will probably be resisted more often, and the stun causes more aggro. It does more DPS when the recast timer is considered, not considering resists. Of course, both nukes could also be used in alternation for even more DPS.

spells.name: Jyll`s Zephyr of Ice
spells.description:
Creates a circle of ice shards around you, causing between 594 damage to all nearby creatures.
Single target mana efficiency of 1.9 DPM.

spells.name: Kazumi's Note of Preservation
spells.description: A single perfect note that surrounds your group with an aura of invulnerability.

spells.name: Largarn`s Lamentation
spells.description: Strikes your target's mind, stunning them briefly and draining their mana.

spells.name: Largo's Assonant Binding
spells.description:
A binding melody that surrounds your target in magical bonds, slowing their movement and attack speed, as well as lowering their agility.

* The spell is listed as Largo's Assonant Binding on the spell vendor.

spells.name: Legacy of Thorn
spells.description: Surrounds your group in a shield of spikes that causes damage to anything that strikes them.

spells.name: Levant
spells.description:
Teleports you through the shadow realm temporarily, reappearing in reality at the safe point of the zone. See [[Travel Guide#Evacuate_Locations|the travel guide]] for locations.

May only be used at night ''(can start using it at 7pm and can no longer use it at 4am)''.

spells.name: Lifespike
spells.description: Drains your target of life energy, siphoning 12 hit points.

spells.name: Lure of Flame
spells.description:
Searing flames consume your target, causing 640 damage. This damage is much more difficult to resist than most spells.
Has a mana efficiency of 2.0, DPS of 138,

spells.name: Lure of Frost
spells.description:
Shards of piercing ice consume your target, causing 640 damage. Mana efficiency of 2.0, DPS of 142.
This damage is much more difficult to resist than most spells.

spells.name: Lure of Ice
spells.description: Shards of piercing ice consume your target, causing 825 damage. This damage is much more difficult to resist than most spells. (2.57 DPM)

spells.name: Lure of Lightning
spells.description:
Bolts of lightning consume your target, causing 680 damage. This damage is much more difficult to resist than most spells.
Mana efficiency of 2.12, DPS of 147.

spells.name: Lyssa's Cataloging Libretto
spells.description: An ancient tune that provides arcane  information about the item that your target is holding.

spells.name: Lyssa's Locating Lyric
spells.description: A clairvoyant chorus which points you towards your target's nearest corpse.  If nothing is targeted then it will point you to the closest corpse of any kind.

spells.name: Mage Bane Poison
spells.description: Coats your weapon in a Mage Bane Poison, giving you a chance to trigger {{SpellHoverLink|Befuddling Strike}} and {{SpellHoverLink|Banishing Strike}} on striking. This is considered a utility poison, only one of which may be active at a time.

spells.name: Mala
spells.description: Strips magical protection from your target, lowering their magic, fire, cold and poison resistances.

spells.name: Malignant Dead
spells.description: Animates an undead servant from the remnants of the fallen. Consumes bone chips when cast.

spells.name: Malo
spells.description:
Decreases your target's resistance to cold, fire, magic, and poison.

Note: Casting this spell is irresistible which will land 100% of the time. This explains it's extremely high price tag and the necessity against high target monsters and end game bosses.

spells.name: Malosi
spells.description: Decreases your target's resistance to cold, fire, magic, and poison.

spells.name: Malosini
spells.description: Decreases your target's resistance to cold, fire, magic, and poison.

spells.name: Manasink
spells.description: Covers your skin in a shimmering shield of mana that absorbs some spell damage.  Consumes a jasper when cast.

spells.name: Manaskin
spells.description:
Covers you in a magical skin that absorbs some damage before dissipating. This spell also increases your mana regeneration rate (1 extra mana point per tick). '''Consumes one peridot when cast'''
''Note: this does NOT stack with the Wiz Epic, Barrier of Force''

spells.name: Manastorm
spells.description: Creates a storm of mana around you, causing 675 damage (x3 waves?) to several creatures near your target, and draining their mana.

spells.name: Manicial Strength
spells.description:
Fills your target's body with maniacal power, increasing their strength for 2 hours 24 mins @ level 57. The buff is classically misspelled as "Manicial".

Provides more STR than the group version, [[Talisman of the Rhino]].

spells.name: Mark of Karn
spells.description: Covers your target in a glowing aura that heals anyone who strikes them. Also removes any existing damageshield on the target.

spells.name: Markar`s Discord
spells.description:
Strikes your target with energy, stunning them briefly and causing 750 damage.

Mana efficiency is 2.5 DPM.

spells.name: Mask of the Hunter
spells.description:
Covers your face in the mask of the hunter for 3 hours @L60, allowing you improved vision, increased mana regeneration, and the ability to see invisible creatures. Does not stack with Form of the Howler, but does stack with Form of the Hunter. Does not stack with Gift of Brilliance.

The "magnification" effect is actually a field of view increase. Both it and the size increase are temporary and will be removed if you zone or camp; the mana regen and see invis remains for the full duration of the buff.

Outdoor zones only. Buff persists indoors but must be applied outdoors.

spells.name: McVaxius' Rousing Rondo
spells.description: This song gives your group a heightened awareness, increasing their attack speed, strength, and surrounding them in an aura that causes damage to anything that strikes them.

spells.name: Memory Flux
spells.description: Attacks your target's mind, providing a chance to forget those that have done them harm.

spells.name: Minion of Shadows
spells.description: Animates an undead servant from the remnants of the fallen. This pet is a rogue and will backstab but has less hit points than the level 49 pet which is a warrior. Consumes bone chips when cast.

spells.name: Monster Summoning III
spells.description: Conjures a pet in the form of a local monster to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Mortal Deftness
spells.description:
Fills your target with a sense of mortal deftness, increasing their dexterity for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

Compare to the group version, [[Talisman of the Raptor]].

spells.name: Naltron's Mark
spells.description:
Covers your group in a shimmer of holy runes, increasing their hit points for 54 mins.

This is a group version of [[Symbol of Naltron]], with slightly lower total HP. This spell consumes one peridot per cast.

spells.name: Nature Walkers Behest
spells.description: Summons the spirit of a wild bear to obey your commands.

spells.name: Nature's Touch
spells.description: Mends severe wounds, healing up to 880 damage. 2.2 HP healed per mana, 160HP/sec

spells.name: Natureskin
spells.description: Hardens the skin of your target, increasing their hit points, regeneration rate, and armor class for 1 hour(s) 21.0 mins.

spells.name: Neurotoxic Poison
spells.description: Coats your weapon in a Neurotoxic Poison, giving you a chance to trigger {{SpellHoverLink|Befuddling Strike}} and {{SpellHoverLink|Weakening Strike}} on striking. This is considered a utility poison, only one of which may be active at a time.

spells.name: Nillipus' March of the Wee
spells.description:
A marching tune that surrounds your group with an aura of protection that absorbs some damage, as well as increasing armor class and agility. All members effected with this song have shrink effect applied, which of course is cancelled when a character is damaged for higher than the Rune shield effect. The shrink has no effect on already small races.

If you click the buff off before it fades on its own, you will remain shrunk indefinitely. A song written by [[Nillipus]] the [[Brownie]] in [[Rivervale]].

spells.name: Niv's Harmonic
spells.description: Surrounds your group in a protective aura, granting them increased armor class.

spells.name: Overwhelming Splendor
spells.description: Increases your charisma.

spells.name: Panic the Dead
spells.description: Inspires fear in an undead opponent, causing them to flee.

spells.name: Paralytic Poison
spells.description: Coats your weapon in a Paralytic Poison, giving you a chance to trigger {{SpellHoverLink|Weakening Strike}} and {{SpellHoverLink|Clumsiness Strike}} on striking. This is considered a utility poison, only one of which may be active at a time.

spells.name: Paralyzing Earth
spells.description: Causes the earth to adhere to your target's feet, preventing them from moving for up to 3 min.

spells.name: Phantom Armor
spells.description: Covers you in phantom armor, increasing your hit point regeneration and armor class. Consumes '''four''' cat's eye agates when cast.

spells.name: Pillar of Flame
spells.description:
Creates a pillar of flame, causing between 937 and 952 damage to several creatures in the vicinity of your target. Single target mana efficiency of about 2.6 damage per mana.

This is a '''recommended''' quad-kiting spell for Wizards, replacing [[Pillar of Lightning]].

spells.name: Pillar of Frost
spells.description:
Creates a pillar of frost, causing between 755 and 800 damage on up to four creatures in the vicinity of your target. Single target mana efficiency is 2.32 to 2.46.

This is a '''recommended''' quad-kiting spell for Wizards, replacing [[Circle of Force]] and being replaced by [[Pillar of Lightning]].

spells.name: Pillar of Lightning
spells.description:
Creates a pillar of lightning, causing between 828 and 848 damage to several creatures on up to four creatures in the vicinity of your target. Single target mana efficiency of 2.4 / 2.46.

This is a '''recommended''' quad-kiting spell for Wizards, replacing [[Pillar of Frost]] and being replaced by [[Pillar of Flame]].

spells.name: Plague
spells.description: Sickens your target with a fever, causing 144 damage initially and between 147 and 156 damage every six seconds for 1 min 18s.

spells.name: Plainsight
spells.description: Focuses your vision, allowing you to see otherwise invisible creatures, and allowing greatly improved night vision.

spells.name: Porlos' Fury
spells.description:
'''Eligible Targets:''' *[[Lord Yelinak]] *[[Telkorenar]] *[[Gozzrem]] *[[Lendiniara the Keeper]] *[[Dozekar the Cursed]] *[[Aaryonar]] *[[Lady Mirenilla]] *[[Lady Nevederia]] *[[Lord Feshlak]] *[[Lord Koi'Doken]] *[[Lord Kreizenn]] *[[Lord Vyemm]] *[[Vulak`Aerr]] *[[Ventani the Warder]] *[[Nanzata the Warder]] *[[Tukaarak the Warder]] *[[Hraashna the Warder]]
Consumes your target in the fury of Porlos, causing 2000 damage to certain types of dragons. Consumes a pair of peridots when cast. Can only be cast on a select list of mobs! See list at right.

spells.name: Pouch of Quellious
spells.description: Focuses mana into the form of a pouch of Quellious, filled with magical shurikens.

spells.name: Pox of Bertoxxulous
spells.description: Sickens your target with a fever, causing 90 damage initially and 111 damage every six seconds for 1.8 minutes, total of 2088 damage & 4.86dpm.

spells.name: Primal Avatar
spells.description:
Infuses your target with the power of an avatar, increasing their strength, dexterity, agility, and attack rating for 6.0 mins @L60 to 6.5 mins @L65. Unlike [[Avatar]], this spell consumes no [[Emerald]]s.

This spell is scribed from a NO DROP scroll which drops in [[Sleeper's Tomb]] only.

This spell stacks with all other buffs except [[Primal Essence]].

spells.name: Protection of the Glades
spells.description: Hardens the skin of your group, increasing their hit points, mana regeneration, and armor class for 1 hour(s) 40.0 mins.  Also known as PotG. The glades confer a great boon to any adventurer, unrestricted by normal Kunark era minimum level requirements. [[Aegolism]] and PotG do not stack with each other and neither will override the other.

spells.name: Pyrocruor
spells.description: Burns the blood of your target, causing 111 damage every six seconds for 1.9 minutes (19 ticks) for a total of 2109 damage. 5.273 DPM.

spells.name: Quiver of Marr
spells.description: Focuses mana into the form of the quiver of Marr filled with magical arrows.

spells.name: Quivering Veil of Xarn
spells.description:
Surrounds your body in the veil of Xarn, rendering you invulnerable for 18 secs (3 ticks) as well as healing you for 150. 


* Note:Quivering Veil is currently blocked by Arch Lich, a bug report has been submitted.
* Only works at night until Oct2001.[https://project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=410915]{{Era | Chardok}}
* Telin: [Oct2001] Quivering Veil of Xarn is castable at all times of day.[https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=410915]
* There is a negative component to this spell and a current bug, too: if demi-lich is already on, it will fade away when the spell fades.  The bug currently blocks while in Arch Lich form. 
* Additionally, zoning using this spell will render it useless, unlike its lower level counterpart [[Harmshield]], which will persist when zoning.

spells.name: Rage of Zomm
spells.description:
Summons an elemental that attacks your target relentlessly until either your target or the elemental dies. The magician cannot command the elemental in any way, this includes turning off pet taunt.

The elemental is very fragile - an [[orc pawn]] was able to one-shot it.

spells.name: Rapture
spells.description: Causes your opponent to fall into an enchanted sleep for up to 24 secs (4 ticks).  This spell works on creatures up to level 61.  This spell is unresistible by mobs that aren't immune to mez. (17.70 mana per second)

spells.name: Recant Magic
spells.description: Tears the magic from your target, causing their enchantments to fade.

spells.name: Reckoning
spells.description: Calls upon the reckoning of the gods to strike your target, causing between 630 and 675 damage with a ''very'' slight knockback effect. (2.5 - 2.7 DPM)

spells.name: Regrowth
spells.description:
Hastens your target's natural healing, regenerating 15 hit points every 6 seconds.
If the target regenerates lost health for the entire duration, it can be considered as a 2490 point heal at level 52, for a mana efficiency of 8.3 hp/m. This effect does not stack with wort pot's effect, [[Calimony]] (see [[Buff Lines#HP_Regeneration_.28Primary.29| Buff Lines]] for further info). This spell follows the kunark level restrictions (minimum level 41 to receive).

spells.name: Regrowth of the Grove
spells.description: Hastens your groups natural healing, allowing them to recover hit points faster.

spells.name: Remedy
spells.description: Mends major wounds, healing between 433 and 438 hit points. 2.5 healing/mana ratio.  See [[Healing Spell Lines]] to compare with other heals.

spells.name: Repulse Animal
spells.description: Incites fear in an [[:Category:Animal | animal]] target, causing them to flee.

spells.name: Resist Cold
spells.description: Surrounds your target with an aura of protection, warding away cold for 36 min.

spells.name: Resist Disease
spells.description: Surrounds your target with an aura of protection, warding away disease for 36 min.

spells.name: Resist Magic
spells.description: Surrounds your target with an aura of protection, warding away magic for 36 min.

spells.name: Resolution
spells.description: Provides your target with a sense of resolution, increasing their hit points and armor class for 63 min.

spells.name: Rest the Dead
spells.description: Numbs the awareness of the undead, making them less likely to attack. This spell works on creatures up to level 50.

spells.name: Restoration
spells.description: Revives a slain ally, restoring 75% of their lost experience. It takes some time for the recently revived to fully recover.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: Revives a slain ally, restoring 90% of their lost experience. It takes some time for the recently revived to fully recover.

spells.name: Retribution of Al`Kabor
spells.description:
Creates a freezing wind that causes between 861 and 901 damage to several creatures in the vicinity of your target.
Singe target mana efficiency of 1.36 DPM at lvl 60

spells.name: Reviviscence
spells.description: Revives a slain ally, restoring nearly all of their lost experience.  It takes some time for the recently revived to fully recover.

spells.name: Riotous Health
spells.description: Fills your target with riotous health, increasing their stamina for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

spells.name: Rune V
spells.description:
Covers your target in a shimmer of runes that absorb damage. Consumes 1x or 2x peridots when cast. (Absorbs 2HP per mana)
***NOTE: This is a 51+ Kunark era spell and thus has a minimum level requirement of 39 (see [[Game Mechanics]])

spells.description:
Consumes a willing target's soul and binds it within an [[Essence Emerald]]. Players (Level 46-59) killed in this manner cannot be resurrected. Consumes an [[emerald]] when cast. You cannot sacrifice yourself.

spells.name: Scars of Sigil
spells.description: Burns your target's skin with the scars of Sigil, causing 450 damage (2.57 DPM). This is a quick cast fire-bolt.

spells.name: Scent of Terris
spells.description: Surrounds your target in the scent of Terris, causing them to be more susceptible to fire, poison, and disease.

spells.name: Scintillation
spells.description: Creates a circle of fire around you, causing between 597 and 608 damage to all nearby creatures.

spells.name: Scoriae
spells.description: Ignites your target's skin, doing 688 damage. 2.75 damage per mana

spells.name: Sedulous Subversion
spells.description: Restores your target's mana at the expense of your own.

spells.name: Seeking Flame of Seukor
spells.description: Burns your target's skin with the seeking flame of Seukor, causing 1024 damage (3.20 DPM).

spells.name: Selo's Assonant Strain
spells.description: A compelling song that surrounds all nearby creatures in magical bonds, slowing their attack speed and movement rate. This song does not stack with lv48 [[Selo's Chords of Cessation]]

spells.name: Selo's Song of Travel
spells.description: This song allows freedom of movement, providing levitation, increased movement speed, the ability to see invisible creatures, and granting invisibility for your group. Please note, that if you are attacked by a critter that has see-invisibility (like a skeleton for example) this will cancel the whole buff.

spells.name: Servant of Bones
spells.description: Animates an undead servant from the remnants of the fallen.  Consumes bone chips when cast.

spells.name: Shadowbond
spells.description: Transfers your own health to your target at a rate of 125 hit points every six seconds for 24 secs (4 ticks).

spells.name: Shield of Blades
spells.description: Surrounds your target in a shield of spikes that causes damage to anything that strikes them. Minimum Level for target: 44

spells.name: Shield of Spikes
spells.description: Surrounds your target in a shield of spikes that cause damage to anything that strikes them for 15 min.

spells.name: Shield of the Magi
spells.description:
Surrounds your body in a magical shield, increasing your hit points, armor class, and magic resistance.

Does not stack with [[Focus of Spirit]], regardless of buff order.

spells.name: Shield of Words
spells.description: Covers your target in a holy guard, increasing their armor class for 72 min.

spells.name: Shock of Steel
spells.description: Conjures a shock of steel that assaults your target.

spells.name: Shroud of Death
spells.description: Imbues your attacks with a chance to steal life energy (50 points per proc) from your target for 20.0 mins.

spells.name: Shroud of the Spirits
spells.description: Places a shroud of spirits on your target, increasing their armor class for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

spells.name: Shroud of Undeath
spells.description:
Transforms you into a skeleton, imbuing your attacks with a chance to steal life energy (Max: 50) from your target for 20.0 mins. 
Note that Skeletal form prevents slam, making it a bit less useful for Trolls & Ogres

spells.name: Sirocco
spells.description: Conjures a blistering wind that assaults several creatures in the vicinity of your target, causing three waves of between 630 and @1 damage.

spells.description: Hardens the skin of your target, increasing their hit points and armor class for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

spells.description: Covers your body in the skin of the shadow, granting invisibility and improved night vision. Only usable at night. Fixed duration invisibility, similar to Improved Invisibility provided to other caster classes.

spells.name: Solon's Charismatic Concord
spells.description: Increases the charisma rating of your entire group.

spells.name: Song of Dawn
spells.description: The sounds of the dawn confuse your enemy and make them more likely to attack a different target. Daytime usable.

spells.name: Song of Highsun
spells.description: An odd tune that strips mystic enchantments from your target and causes them to teleport to their home point. Daytime usable. If used on a Player Character it has the same effect as [[Shadow Step]]

spells.name: Song of Midnight
spells.description: The dark sounds of the night cause your enemies to rapidly flee in terror. This song only works at night time.

spells.name: Song of Twilight
spells.description: A quiet lullaby that causes your target to fall into an enchanted sleep.  Affects creatures up to level @54.

spells.name: Song: Composition of Ervaj
spells.description: An ancient song that increases the attack speed of your group.  This increase is cumulative with most other effects that increase attack speed. It does stack with other haste buffs, it does not bypass the [[Haste_Guide#Haste_Caps|Haste_Cap]].

spells.name: Song: Occlusion of Sound
spells.description: An aura of silence envelops your enemy, causing them to become more susceptible to fire, ice, and magic.

spells.name: Spirit of Oak
spells.description: Transforms you into a stout tree, preventing movement, but increasing your regeneration. Does not stack with Protection of the Glades. Outdoor only.

spells.name: Spirit of Scale
spells.description: Imbues your group with the spirit of a scaled wolf, increasing their movement speed for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.  Any attack, or spell cast will break the enchantment. The single target version of this spell is [[Scale of Wolf]].

spells.name: Spirit of the Howler

Summons a companion from the spirit world in the form of a great wolf.
Max Pet Level 39
Max HP 2050
HP Regen/tick 30
Max hit 52*
Max Kick 24
Abilities Double Attack, Riposte, Shield

spells.name: Splurt
spells.description: Causes your target's body to splurt, doing progressively more damage the longer it lasts (17 ticks). -1819hp & 7.5792 dpm.

spells.name: Steelskin
spells.description: Surrounds your skin in a protective aura that absorbs 230 damage. Consumes a jasper when cast.

spells.name: Storm Strength
spells.description: Fills your target with the power of the storm, increasing their strength for 54 min.

spells.name: Strength of Nature
spells.description:
Blesses your target with the strength of nature, increasing their hit points and attack rating for 1 hour.

Doesn't stack with [[Paladin]]s' [[Divine Strength]], but does stack with [[Cleric]] and [[Shaman]] buffs.

Doesn't stack with some ATK buffs such as [[Grim Aura]], [[Firefist]],  [[Yaulp IV]], and [[Celestial Tranquility]].

This effect blocks the use of [[10 Dose Potion of Stinging Wort]]s.

spells.name: Stun Command
spells.description: Strikes several creatures around your target with holy might, briefly stunning them.

spells.name: Stunning Strike
spells.description: Injects a paralytic agent, stunning your opponent. This effect works on creatures up to level 50.

spells.name: Succor
spells.description:
Opens a mystical portal that transports your group to a relatively safe location in the current zone. The chaotic nature of the portal drains mana from anyone who passes through it. See [[Travel Guide#Evacuate_Locations|the travel guide]] for locations.
Compare to the Wizard's [[Evacuate]]. '''Drains a total of 1025 mana from the caster. Use [[Egress]] if you are solo and only evacuating yourself. Also drains 750 mana from group members. Decreased mana of entire group, including caster, by 750 (not 150) until Luclin. [http://lucy.allakhazam.com/spellhistory.html?id=1567&source=Live]'''

spells.name: Summon Corpse
spells.description:
Summons your target's corpse to you. Consumes a [[Jade Inlaid Coffin]] when cast. The coffin costs 207 plat with 86 charisma. IMPORTANT: The target must be a group member. If not cast on a group member, the coffin will be consumed to no effect.

This spell was introduced December 1999 [https://wiki.project1999.com/Patch_notes#December_7.2C_1999_Brad.27s_post]

spells.name: Summon: Muzzle of Mardu

spells.name: Swift Like The Wind

spells.description: Covers your target in a shimmer of holy runes, increasing their hit points for 1 hour(s) 3.0 mins. Uses 1 peridot when cast.

spells.description: Covers your target in a shimmer of holy runes, increasing their hit points for 54 min.

spells.name: Talisman of Shadoo
spells.description:
Protects your group with the talisman of Shadoo, shielding them from poison for 36.0 mins.

''Note: No longer stacks with [[Resist Poison]].''

spells.name: Talisman of the Brute
spells.description:
Fills your group with the spirit of the brute, increasing their stamina for 1 hour(s) 3.0 mins.

Note: [[Riotous Health]] provides 10 more stamina.

spells.description:
Fills your group with the spirit of the cat, increasing their agility for 1 hour(s) 3.0 mins.

Provides less AGI than the single target version, [[Deliriously Nimble]].

spells.name: Talisman of the Raptor
spells.description:

spells.description: Tears of searing flame fall around your target, causing three waves of 645 damage to all creatures in the vicinity of your target.

spells.name: The Unspoken Word

spells.name: Thorncoat
spells.description: Surrounds your body in a coat of thorns that increases your armor class, as well as harming those that strike you.

spells.name: Thought Drain Poison
spells.description: Coats your weapon in a Thought Drain Poison, giving you a chance to trigger {{SpellHoverLink|Befuddling Strike}} and {{SpellHoverLink|Clumsiness Strike}} on striking. This is considered a utility poison, only one of which may be active at a time.

spells.description: Commands an undead creature to do your bidding, temporarily bending them to your will.

spells.name: Thunderbold

Calls down a bolt of thunderous energy, causing 600 damage, and briefly stunning up to four creatures in the vicinity of your target.
Single target mana efficency of 2.0.

spells.description: Engulfs creatures near your target in a cloud of insects, slowing their attack rates for 2.9 mins @L58 to 3.5 mins @L70. Max of 4 mobs.

spells.name: Tishan`s Discord
spells.description:
Strikes your target with energy, stunning them briefly and causing 260 damage.

Mana efficiency is 2.0 DPM.

spells.name: Torment of Argli
spells.description: Consumes your target in mental torment, causing 28 damage every six seconds for 2.0 mins. This spell also lowers their intelligence and wisdom, and drains their mana. (560 total damage @ 3.73 DPM)

spells.name: Torpor
spells.description: Places your target into a state of torpor, healing 300 hit points every six seconds for 24 secs (between 4-5 ticks), but vastly decreasing their movement speed and attack rate. This spell has the potential to tick a 5th time, totaling 1500 hit-points, depending on when it lands on your target (similar to how dot ticks work). The overall mana efficiency is 7.5 or 6 hp/m.

spells.name: Torrent of Poison
spells.description:
Creates a rain of poison, causing 1-3 waves of 540 damage to 1-4 creatures in a small radius around your target.
At 1620-2160 damage, the potential blowback from this spell is significant. '''Use with extreme caution''' as it seems to prioritize hitting yourself up to twice if you cast it too close to the selected creature.
This spell seems to either hit four creatures one time,
Two creatures twice,
one creature three times,
or if cast on three creatures it will hit all three and then the original target once more.
If cast on a single creature while you're close to it, there's a chance of yourself and the creature getting hit twice each, or the creature getting hit three times and yourself once.
Despite having no resistance modifier, this spell has a high resist rate on creatures that normally could be hit by every spell you throw their way.

spells.name: Touch of Night
spells.description: Drains your target of life energy, siphoning 720 hit points. 1.77 lifetap efficiency.

spells.name: Translocate: Group
spells.description: Opens an arcane portal that teleports your entire group to their respective bind points.

spells.name: Trepidation
spells.description: A booming voice fills your target's ears, causing them to flee in terror.

spells.name: Trucidation
spells.description: Drains your target of life energy, siphoning 1100 hit points.  Consumes an essence emerald when cast.

spells.description: Engulfs your target in a swarm of insects, slowing their attack rate for 5.1 mins @L51 to 6.5 mins @L65.

spells.name: Turgur`s Insects
spells.description: Engulfs your target in a swarm of insects, slowing their attack rate for 5.1 mins @L51 to 6.0 mins @L60.

spells.name: Umbra
spells.description:
Causes your image to blur, making it harder for your opponents to hit you by increasing your armor class.

Does not stack with [[Aegolism]]

spells.name: Unfailing Reverence
spells.description: Fills your target with an unfailing reverence, increasing their charisma for 1 hour(s) 12.0 mins.

spells.name: Unswerving Hammer
spells.description:
Summons a magical hammer that attacks your target relentlessly until either the hammer or the target dies.

If there are additional mobs on the hammer's hate list, the hammer will stay alive and attack those mobs. The summoning cleric cannot control this hammer at all; e.g., it will always taunt. Using "Go Away" is of unknown use.

The hammer has approximately 10 hp and cannot receive damage shields. It has a max hit of 40-45 depending on level. It can be given most other buffs once summoned (this was removed in later eras). 

This spell does work in Plane of Sky and the hammer appears normally there.

While the spell lists no range, the hammer will despawn very quickly if the target is not close enough to the hammer to begin an initial attack.

The pet may be reclaimed with [[Reclaim Energy]], which increases the utility of the hammer somewhat. This pet is situationally useful for long melee-heavy fights with no AE spells such as [[Ulump Pujluk]] or [[An enraged golem]].

This spell is called Unswerving Hammer of Faith once scribed.

spells.description: Causes the earth to tremble around you, causing between 648 and 728 (Level 59) damage to all nearby enemies.

spells.name: Valiant Companion
spells.description: Fills your elemental pet with mystical valor, rendering them immune to fear effects.

spells.name: Vampiric Curse
spells.description: Drains the life from your target, doing 21 damage every six seconds for 54s. 7% of the life-force taken is used to heal your wounds.

spells.name: Velocity
spells.description: Fills your elemental pet with speed, increasing their movement rate.

spells.name: Vengeance of Al`Kabor
spells.description:
Creates a maelstrom of energy that causes between 942 and 952 damage to several creatures in the vicinity of your target.
Single target mana efficiency of 1.34 / 1.36 DPM. This spell also has a small stun component.

spells.name: Vexing Mordinia
spells.description:
Drains the life from your target, dealing 122 damage per tick for 10 ticks for a total of 1220 damage and 2.46 DPM, and healing the caster for 122 hit points every six seconds for 54 secs (9 ticks). 2.22 tap efficiency. The healing duration is sometimes 10 ticks, discrepancies maybe from server ticks or bug?

'''Does stack with [[Soul Well]], if Soul Well is casted first.'''

spells.name: Vilia's Chorus of Celerity
spells.description: A energetic verse that heightens the attack speed of your group.

spells.name: Visions of Grandeur
spells.description:
Fills your target with energy, increasing their attack speed, dexterity, and attack rating.
Visions of Grandeur does not stack with and is blocked by [[Speed of the Shissar]]. ''Patch change 20 Feb, 2012: Kanras: Updated Visions of Grandeur to longer duration, correct ATK bonus. ''Patch was implemented to address the recast issue, it has been reduced from 16 seconds to 3 per February 21st 2001 patch.

spells.name: Vocarate: Air
spells.description: Summons an air elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Vocarate: Earth
spells.description: Summons an earth elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Vocarate: Fire
spells.description: Summons a fire elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Vocarate: Water
spells.description: Summons a water elemental to aid you in battle.

spells.name: Voice of the Berserker
spells.description:
Fills you with a berserk fury, increasing your strength, dexterity, and armor class for 18.7 mins @L59 to 20.5 mins @L65.
Unlike [[Fury]], [[Frenzy]], and [[Rage]], three earlier self only shaman spells, this one does NOT drain mana rapidly, making this an actual viable spell that might get cast now and then. It does however prevent casting spells for 30 seconds.
Prevents the three previous mentioned spells and [[Fleeting Fury]] from sticking.
If for some reason you don't have max wisdom at level 59 or 60, you can pair this with [[Mortal Deftness]] and [[Manicial Strength]] and [[Focus of Spirit]] for 194 134 bonus Dex and a whopping 219 bonus strength, and use your maxed out str/dex for blacksmithing and fletching respectively.
Edit: Voice of the Berserker overrides [[Mortal Deftness]], and [[Speed of the Shissar]] overrides Voice of the Berserker. [[Primal Essence]] does not interfere with Voice of the Berserker. Casting this spell will cause your spell gems to grey out for 30 seconds but a simple click on any "GCD" item will unlock this and let you cast like normal immediately afterwards.

spells.name: Voltaic Draught
spells.description:
Consumes your target in a sudden torrent of lightning, causing between 658 and 688 damage.
Mana efficiency of 3.06 / 3.2, DPS of 229.
When scribed, is written as Voltaic Draugh.

spells.name: Wake of Karana
spells.description: Channels the will of the Rainkeeper to change the weather (rain or snow) in the current zone.  Consumes an [[Opal]] when cast.

spells.name: Wake of Tranquility
spells.description:
Covers all creatures near your target in tranquility, lowering their aggressiveness for up to 7 minutes.

Affects creatures up to level 60. This spell affects a maximum of 10 Targets per cast.

spells.name: Wave of Healing
spells.description: Emanates a wave of healing from the caster, healing 200 hit points for everyone in your group.

spells.name: Weakening Strike
spells.description: weakens your targets limbs, slowing their attack rate for 0:03:30.

spells.name: Wildfire
spells.description: Ignites your target's skin, doing 1024 damage. 3.2 damage per mana

spells.name: Wind of Tashani
spells.description: Causes your enemies' ears to echo with the barking of Tashan, lowering the magic resistance of all creatures in the vicinity of your target.

spells.name: Wind of Tishanian
spells.description:
Causes the ears of all creatures in a small radius around your target to echo with the barking of Tashan, lowering their magic resistance. <s>Use this spell when you want your character to die fast.</s> Previously caused a high amount of threat.

Usage tips: this spell is often considered garbage but is a good time saver when reverse charming. Root everything down and plop one into the pack. Also good in chardok to drop in a pack and then gating before lulling. Takes a little extra time but makes lulling a lot more reliable on top of having your named pre-tashed.

spells.name: Winds of Gelid
spells.description: Creates a wind of ice around you, causing between 1260 and @1 damage to all nearby creatures.

spells.description: Commands a swarm of insects to attack your target relentlessly, causing 143 damage every six seconds for 60 secs (10 ticks). 4.08 Damage per Mana.

spells.name: Wonderous Rapidity
spells.description:
Grants your target quickened movement, increasing their attack speed for 18.4 mins @L58 to 20.5 mins @L65.
Though [[Wonderous Rapidity]] is a higher percentage haste, [[Visions of Grandeur]] or [[Speed of the Shissar]] are generally preferred for their other stats, especially considering the haste cap is 100% for level 60s and many raiding characters have 36% worn haste or higher.

spells.description: Mends the wounds of everyone in your group, healing between 7500 and @1 hit points.

spells.name: Word of Restoration
spells.description: Mends the wounds of everyone in your group, healing between 720 and 750 hit points as well as curing nine (9) disease and poison counters.

spells.name: Word of Vigor
spells.description: Mends the major wounds, healing between 537 and 620 hit points, and replenishes 100 Stamina to everyone in your group in range. Heals group for 590 each. [[Talk:Word of Vigor|See Discussion.]]

spells.name: Wrath of the Elements
spells.description:
Surrounds your target in an elemental maelstrom, causing 350 damage initially, and between 122 and 132 damage every 6 seconds for 30 secs (5 ticks).

If it lasts the entire duration it will deal an average of 350 + 127 * 5 = 985 (max 1010).  Given the spell's cost that adds up to a 985/265 = 3.72 average damage per mana (DPM).

Does not stack with [[Deadly Velium Poison]].

spells.name: Yaulp III
spells.description: Focuses your spiritual energy into a great battle cry, increasing your strength and armor class.

spells.name: Yaulp IV
spells.description:
Focuses your spiritual energy into a great battle cry, increasing your strength, armor class, and attack rating for 24 secs (4 ticks). It does not stack with [[Speed of the Shissar]].

Increased ATK by 27 (L53) to 31 (L60) until Feb. 2001, when Paladins gained the spell.

spells.description: Animates a pair of swords to attack your enemies.  Consumes three tiny daggers when cast.
